description: Express.js route definitions for session management, including tenant listing and selection, with audit logging and RBAC validation.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: Returns list of tenants for authenticated user with audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Sets active tenant in session, with RBAC validation, cookie setting, and audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias route to select tenant, reusing the /tenant handler.
